第62章 天珠示警-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

存书签

第二个排查点在天后庙道附近。

依然先用笔记本电脑探查了一番监控情况，没发现问题。

只有傻瓜式排查了。

电气道边上一排唐楼，六层高，没电梯，全靠腿。

顾承安换了身装备——蓝色pOlO衫，深色休闲裤，脚上一双旧款运动鞋。

肤蜡重新修了一遍，这回把颧骨垫高了一点，下颌线条也做了微调，整体轮廓从方正变成了圆润。配上那副金丝边眼镜，活脱脱一个来港岛出差的内地中层干部。

唐楼没有门禁。

楼梯间窄得只能容一个半人并排走，墙面陈旧，贴满了小广告——搬家公司、开锁换锁、通渠服务。

顾承安一层一层走上去。

手机没有反应。

他走到顶层，推开天台的铁门，站在水泥护栏边扫了一眼周边建筑的布局——视野不算开阔，但能看到三条街外的主干道。如果马克·西蒙选择藏在这一带，这些天台就是他的天然观察哨。

护栏上有几个烟蒂。

顾承安蹲下来看了看。双喜牌，本地品牌，痕迹不新鲜，至少一周以上。旁边还有两个空啤酒罐，蓝妹啤酒，铝罐表面的水渍已经干透了。

像是附近住户上来乘凉留下的。

他没有多做停留，原路下楼。

接下来两栋也是类似情况——老旧、拥挤、人口密度大、居住者以本地老年人和东南亚租客为主，手机全程沉默。

走完天后片区的三栋目标楼宇，已经接近中午十二点。

顾承安在电气道拐角一家茶餐厅坐下来，点了份叉烧饭加冻柠茶。

茶餐厅不大，十来张桌子挤得密密匝匝，午市高峰还没到，客人只有四五桌。

顾承安吃着饭，脑子却没闲着。

两个片区排查完毕，没有发现问题。剩下的备选区域还有三个。按今天的进度，最多再走一个半。

但他的思维没有停在排查进度上。

他在想另一件事——马克·西蒙的行为模式。

黎志义的记忆里有一个细节，每次马克·西蒙跟他见面，上车之后第一件事不是说话，而是拿出一个巴掌大的设备在车内扫一圈。那东西黎志义不认识，但从操作方式来看，十有八九是信号探测器。

这说明马克·西蒙不信任任何人，包括合作了多年的黎志义。

反过来推——这个人在日常生活中的警惕程度只会更高。

如果他住在老式唐楼里，那他一定会对楼内的异常出入保持高度敏感。任何不属于这栋楼的面孔，只要出现两次以上，就会触发他的警觉。

The second investigation point is near Tin Hau Temple Road.

I still used my laptop to check the monitoring situation and found no problem.

There is only foolproof troubleshooting.

There is a row of tenement buildings next to the electric road. They are six stories high. There is no elevator and they all rely on legs.

Gu Chengan changed his outfit - a blue pOlO shirt, dark casual pants, and a pair of old sneakers.

The skin wax was retouched, this time the cheekbones were raised a bit, the jaw line was also slightly adjusted, and the overall contour changed from square to rounded.Paired with those gold-rimmed glasses, he looks like a middle-level cadre from the Mainland who is on a business trip to Hong Kong Island.

The tenement building has no access control.

The stairwell is so narrow that it can only accommodate one and a half people walking side by side. The walls are old and covered with small advertisements - moving companies, lock opening and changing, and drainage services.

Gu Chengan walked up one level at a time.

The phone is unresponsive.

He walked to the top floor, pushed open the iron door of the rooftop, stood by the cement guardrail and glanced at the layout of the surrounding buildings - the view was not wide, but he could see the main road three streets away.If Maxim Simon chose to hide in this area, these rooftops would be his natural observation posts.

There were several cigarette butts on the guardrail.

Gu Chengan knelt down and took a look.Double Happiness, a local brand, is not fresh, at least a week old.There are two empty beer cans next to them, Blue Girl Beer. The water stains on the surface of the aluminum cans have dried completely.

It seemed like it was left behind by nearby residents who came to enjoy the shade.

He didn't stop much and went downstairs the same way.

The next two buildings were in a similar situation - old, crowded, with high population density, and the residents were mainly local elderly people and Southeast Asian tenants. The mobile phones were silent throughout the whole process.

After walking through the three target buildings in the Tin Hau area, it was already close to 12 noon.

Gu Chengan sat down at a tea restaurant on the corner of Electric Road and ordered barbecued pork rice and frozen lemon tea.

The tea restaurant is not big, with about ten tables crowded together. The lunch rush has not yet arrived, so there are only four or five tables of customers.

Gu Chengan was eating, but his mind was not idle.

The two areas were inspected and no problems were found.There are three alternative areas left.According to today's progress, we can walk another half at most.

But his mind did not stop at the investigation progress.

He was thinking about something else—Marc Simon’s pattern of behavior.

There is a detail in Li Zhiyi's memory. Every time Marc Simon met him, the first thing he did after getting in the car was not to speak. Instead, he took out a palm-sized device and scanned the car.Li Zhiyi didn't recognize that thing, but judging from the way it operated, it was most likely a signal detector.

This shows that Mark Simon does not trust anyone, including Li Zhiyi, who has been working with him for many years.

Working the other way around - the person will only be more vigilant in their daily lives.

If he lived in an old tenement building, he would be highly sensitive to unusual comings and goings in the building.Any face that does not belong to this building will trigger his alert if it appears more than twice.
